chapter_en: The chapters on avoiding suits, brawls, filing a plaint and a grave charge

units.chapter_en: The chapter on guarding against trouble and avoiding suits
units.title: 防非避讼章·忧虑官司：喜官鬼空破，最宜子孙发动或持世则无非；鬼雀同动口舌难免，蛇鬼克世灾患相侵，玄武鬼必因盗贼阴人，白虎鬼必有伤痕见血；世动克应是我兴词，应克世爻是他有讼

rule.yi: 担心官司的，喜欢官鬼落在空亡或月破，最适宜子孙发动、子孙持世，就没有是非；官鬼和朱雀一起发动，口舌免不了；螣蛇官鬼克世，灾祸忧患相侵；玄武官鬼，必定因盗贼和阴人；白虎官鬼，必定有伤痕见血；世爻动而克应爻，是我兴词告人；应爻克世爻，是他有讼要告我。
rule.en: In worrying about a lawsuit, one is glad that Pressure is Void or broken, and most fit is Output moving or holding the Self, which means no trouble; Pressure and the Vermilion Bird moving together mean quarrels cannot be avoided; the Coiling Snake and Pressure controlling the Self mean calamity and distress press in; the Dark Tortoise and Pressure surely come from thieves and women; the White Tiger and Pressure surely mean wounds and blood; the Self moving to control the Other means I file a plaint; the Other controlling the Self means he has a suit against me.

zh: 忧虑官司，却喜官居空破，最宜子动、子孙持世，无非；
鬼雀同兴，口舌不免；
蛇鬼克世，灾患相侵；
玄武鬼，必因盗贼阴人；
白虎鬼，定有伤痕见血；
世动克应，我兴词；
应克世爻，他有讼。
yi: 担心官司的，却喜欢官鬼落在空亡或月破，最适宜子孙发动、子孙持世，就没有是非；
官鬼和朱雀一起发动，口舌免不了；
螣蛇官鬼克世，灾祸忧患相侵；
玄武官鬼，必定因盗贼和阴人；
白虎官鬼，必定有伤痕见血；
世爻动而克应爻，是我兴词告人；
应爻克世爻，是他有讼要告我。
en: In worrying about a lawsuit, one is glad that Pressure is Void or broken, and most fit is Output moving or holding the Self, which means no trouble;
Pressure and the Vermilion Bird moving together mean quarrels cannot be avoided;
the Coiling Snake and Pressure controlling the Self mean calamity and distress press in;
the Dark Tortoise and Pressure surely come from thieves and women;
the White Tiger and Pressure surely mean wounds and blood;
the Self moving to control the Other means I file a plaint;
the Other controlling the Self means he has a suit against me.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on guarding against trouble and avoiding suits
units.title: 防非避讼章·子孙动或持世必不成非，鬼持世、鬼克世、应动克世定然成讼

rule.yi: 子孙发动、子孙持世，必定不成是非；官鬼持世、官鬼克世、应爻发动克世，一定成讼。
rule.en: Output moving or holding the Self surely means no trouble arises; Pressure holding the Self, Pressure controlling the Self, or the Other moving to control the Self surely means a suit arises.

zh: 子孙动、子孙持世，必不成非；
鬼持世、鬼克世、应动克世，定然成讼。
yi: 子孙发动、子孙持世，必定不成是非；
官鬼持世、官鬼克世、应爻发动克世，一定成讼。
en: Output moving or holding the Self surely means no trouble arises;
Pressure holding the Self, Pressure controlling the Self, or the Other moving to control the Self surely means a suit arises.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on brawls and contests
units.title: 斗殴争竞章·彼此相争看世应：不宜冲克，喜相生；日月克身我必受辱，动爻克应他必遭刑；应克世他胜，世克应我赢；世空世破世动化退我胆怯，应动应旺应化进神他得势；六冲必散，六合必成

rule.yi: 彼此相争，要看世爻应爻：不适宜冲克，喜欢相生；日月克身，我必定受辱；动爻克应爻，他必定遭刑；应爻克世爻他胜，世爻克应爻我赢。世爻空、世爻破、世爻动而化退，我心里胆怯；应爻动、应爻旺、应爻化进神，他得势了。卦遇六冲一定散，卦逢六合一定成。
rule.en: When the two sides contest, look to the Self and the Other: clash and control are not fit and giving life is welcome; if the Month or the Day controls the Body, I surely suffer insult; if a moving line controls the Other, he surely suffers punishment; the Other controlling the Self means he wins, the Self controlling the Other means I win. The Self Void, the Self broken, or the Self moving and changing into a Retreating spirit means I am timid at heart; the Other moving, the Other strong, or the Other changing into an Advancing spirit means he has the upper hand. A hexagram meeting six-clash surely breaks up; a hexagram meeting six-combine surely comes to terms.

zh: 彼此相争寻世应，不宜冲克喜相生，日月克身，我必受辱；
动爻克应，他必遭刑；
应克世他胜，世克应我赢。
世空世破、世动化退，我心怯焉；
应动应旺、应化进神，他得势矣。
卦遇六冲必散，卦逢六合必成。
yi: 彼此相争，要看世爻应爻：不适宜冲克，喜欢相生；日月克身，我必定受辱；
动爻克应爻，他必定遭刑；
应爻克世爻他胜，世爻克应爻我赢。
世爻空、世爻破、世爻动而化退，我心里胆怯；
应爻动、应爻旺、应爻化进神，他得势了。
卦遇六冲一定散，卦逢六合一定成。
en: When the two sides contest, look to the Self and the Other: clash and control are not fit and giving life is welcome; if the Month or the Day controls the Body, I surely suffer insult;
if a moving line controls the Other, he surely suffers punishment;
the Other controlling the Self means he wins, the Self controlling the Other means I win.
The Self Void, the Self broken, or the Self moving and changing into a Retreating spirit means I am timid at heart;
the Other moving, the Other strong, or the Other changing into an Advancing spirit means he has the upper hand.
A hexagram meeting six-clash surely breaks up; a hexagram meeting six-combine surely comes to terms.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on brawls and contests
units.title: 斗殴争竞章·总不离乎子孙爻：子孙发动、子孙持世，争斗不成；日月动爻宜克应不宜克世；世爻宜旺动克应及动而化吉，官事必赢

rule.yi: 总不离子孙爻：子孙发动、子孙持世，争斗打不起来；日月和动爻适宜克应爻，不适宜克世爻；世爻适宜旺相发动去克应爻，以及动而化出吉的，官事一定赢。
rule.en: It never leaves the Output line: Output moving or holding the Self means the fight does not come off; the Month, the Day and moving lines are fit to control the Other and unfit to control the Self; the Self is fit to be strong and moving to control the Other, or to move and change into something lucky, and then the official matter is surely won.

zh: 总不离乎子孙爻，子发动、子持世，争斗不成；
日月动爻宜于克应，不宜克世；
世宜旺动克应及动而化吉，官事必赢。
yi: 总不离子孙爻：子孙发动、子孙持世，争斗打不起来；
日月和动爻适宜克应爻，不适宜克世爻；
世爻适宜旺相发动去克应爻，以及动而化出吉的，官事一定赢。
en: It never leaves the Output line: Output moving or holding the Self means the fight does not come off;
the Month, the Day and moving lines are fit to control the Other and unfit to control the Self;
the Self is fit to be strong and moving to control the Other, or to move and change into something lucky, and then the official matter is surely won.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on filing a plaint and bringing a suit
units.title: 兴词举讼章·官父同兴公庭有理、父官克世受屈含冤：世化退神、世空世破、卦变六冲、世被刑冲，终不成讼；财与子孙同动克破文书官鬼，也不成

rule.yi: 官鬼和父母同时发动，在公堂上有理；父母、官鬼克世爻，受屈含冤。世爻化退神、世爻空或破、卦变成六冲、世爻被刑冲，终究不成讼；财爻和子孙同时发动，克破文书和官鬼，也主不成。
rule.en: Pressure and Resource moving together, one is in the right in the public hall; Resource and Pressure controlling the Self, one suffers wrong and swallows the grievance. The Self changing into a Retreating spirit, the Self Void or broken, the hexagram changing into six-clash, or the Self punished or clashed, in the end no suit is brought; Wealth and Output moving together to control and break the papers and Pressure also means it is not brought.

zh: 官父同兴，公庭有理，父官克世，受屈含冤。
世化退神、世空世破、卦变六冲、世被刑冲，终不成讼；
财与子孙同动，克破文书官鬼，亦主不成。
yi: 官鬼和父母同时发动，在公堂上有理，父母、官鬼克世爻，受屈含冤。
世爻化退神、世爻空或破、卦变成六冲、世爻被刑冲，终究不成讼；
财爻和子孙同时发动，克破文书和官鬼，也主不成。
en: Pressure and Resource moving together, one is in the right in the public hall; Resource and Pressure controlling the Self, one suffers wrong and swallows the grievance.
The Self changing into a Retreating spirit, the Self Void or broken, the hexagram changing into six-clash, or the Self punished or clashed, in the end no suit is brought;
Wealth and Output moving together to control and break the papers and Pressure also means it is not brought.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on a grave charge already fixed
units.title: 已定重罪章·福宜旺相最忌官兴：子孙持世、子孙发动，已赴法场终必赦免；官鬼克世或持世又被日月动爻冲克，或世动化凶，虽定轻罪也拘改重

rule.yi: 子孙适宜旺相，最忌官鬼兴盛。子孙持世、子孙发动，已经送到法场，终究会赦免；官鬼克世爻、或官鬼持世，又被日月动爻冲克，或者世爻发动化出凶的，虽然判的是轻罪也会拘押改判为重罪。
rule.en: Output should be strong, and Pressure flourishing is most feared. Output holding the Self or moving, even one already taken to the execution ground is in the end pardoned; Pressure controlling the Self or holding the Self and also clashed or controlled by the Month, the Day or a moving line, or the Self moving and changing into something ill, means that though a light sentence is fixed he is held and it is changed to a heavy one.

zh: 福宜旺相，最忌官兴。
子孙持世，子孙发动，已赴法场，终必赦免。
官鬼克世、或官鬼持世，又被日月动爻冲克，或世动化凶，虽定轻罪拘改重。
yi: 子孙适宜旺相，最忌官鬼兴盛。
子孙持世、子孙发动，已经送到法场，终究会赦免；
官鬼克世爻、或官鬼持世，又被日月动爻冲克，或者世爻发动化出凶的，虽然判的是轻罪也会拘押改判为重罪。
en: Output should be strong, and Pressure flourishing is most feared.
Output holding the Self or moving, even one already taken to the execution ground is in the end pardoned;

Pressure controlling the Self or holding the Self and also clashed or controlled by the Month, the Day or a moving line, or the Self moving and changing into something ill, means that though a light sentence is fixed he is held and it is changed to a heavy one.

units.chapter_en: The chapter on seeking luck and avoiding harm
units.title: 趋避章·书中例，占定何罪：木鬼临白虎绞罪已定，但世临月建、木鬼虽动又被酉金回头之克、外卦反吟，事必反复，虽定绞罪终有改移；后来议绞罪，蒙驳审减轻

rule.yi: 蛇雀木鬼犯官刑，临火须防焚害；蛇木又言缢绞，勾陈土鬼牢狱。书中例：未月癸亥日占判定什么罪，得中孚卦变临卦：木鬼临白虎，绞罪是定了；但幸好世爻临月建，木鬼虽然发动，又被酉金回头之克，外卦反吟，事情一定反复，虽然定了绞罪，终究会有改动；果然议的是绞罪，后来蒙驳回重审减轻。
rule.en: The Coiling Snake or Vermilion Bird with Wood Pressure offends against the official penalty, and with Fire beware of burning; the Coiling Snake and Wood also speak of hanging or strangling, and the Hook Earth with Earth Pressure of jail. Worked example: in the Wei month, on a Guihai day, a man divined what charge would be fixed and got Zhongfu changing to Lin: Wood Pressure on the White Tiger means a sentence of strangulation is fixed; but fortunately the Self sits on the Month, and though the Wood Pressure moves it is controlled by a turning-back control from You-metal, and the outer trigram is Reversed Chant, so the matter will surely go back and forth; though strangulation is fixed there will in the end be a change; indeed strangulation was recommended, and later the case was sent back for retrial and the sentence reduced.

zh: 蛇雀木鬼犯官刑，临火须防焚害；
蛇木又言缢绞，勾陈土鬼牢狱，
yi: 螣蛇、朱雀带着木鬼，会犯官府的刑罚；临到火，要提防被火烧。
蛇木又言缢绞，勾陈土鬼牢狱。
en: The Coiling Snake or Vermilion Bird with Wood Pressure offends against the official penalty, and with Fire beware of burning;
the Coiling Snake and Wood also speak of hanging or strangling, and the Hook Earth with Earth Pressure of jail.

zh: 如：未月癸亥日(旬空：子丑)，占定何罪，得“中孚之临”
yi: 如：未月癸亥日（旬空子、丑），占判定什么罪，得中孚卦变临卦。
en: For example: in the Wei month, on a Guihai day (Void: Zi and Chou), divining what charge would be fixed and getting Zhongfu changing to Lin.

zh: 木鬼临白虎，绞罪定矣！
但幸世临月建，木鬼虽动，又被酉金回头之克，外卦反吟，事必反复，虽定绞罪，终有改移。
果议绞罪，后蒙驳审从减（驳番拨活罪）。
yi: 木鬼临白虎，绞罪是定了！
但幸好世爻临月建，木鬼虽然发动，又被酉金回头之克，外卦反吟，事情一定反复，虽然定了绞罪，终究会有改动。
果然议的是绞罪，后来蒙驳回重审减轻。
en: Wood Pressure on the White Tiger means a sentence of strangulation is fixed!

But fortunately the Self sits on the Month, and though the Wood Pressure moves it is controlled by a turning-back control from You-metal, and the outer trigram is Reversed Chant, so the matter will surely go back and forth; though strangulation is fixed there will in the end be a change.
Indeed strangulation was recommended, and later the case was sent back for retrial and the sentence reduced.

note.yi: 原文的小注「驳番拨活罪」是说驳回重审后拨作可以活命的罪名；这里译作驳回重审后减轻。
note.en: The original's small note says the case was sent back and reassigned to a charge that lets the man live; it is rendered as sent back for retrial and reduced.
